title: pilosella × bifurca subsp. comata
intro: Pilosella × bifurca subsp. comata, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family, is a hybrid of Pilosella bifurca and Pilosella officinarum. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to aid in digestion and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella × bifurca subsp. comata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential uses of this plant.
